Finnish American Historical Archive at the Finnish American Heritage Center (FAHC), historically part of Finlandia / Suomi College (archive est. 1932). After the 2023 closure, Finlandia Foundation National became caretaker (offer accepted 15 Jun 2023) and purchased the FAHC building and North Wind Books (announced Jan 2024). Surviving public destination: FAHC, 435 Quincy St., Hancock, MI — FAHC describes the largest Finnish-North American collection, including Finnish-American artwork and two 1642 Christina Bibles. Distinct from the closed Sulo and Aileen Maki circulating library (libraries.org 2443). IPEDS book counts are the university library survey, not FAHC item counts.

Cardinal Stritch University Library is listed permanently closed on libraries.org (id 4269; NCES LIBID 238430). libraries.org reports a circulating academic collection; IPEDS AL shows 120,280 physical books (2021).
